decision_predictions.explanation: CASE-89C39620E3 (OBS-8B9D1C52, 16:48 over 5): the active source is the highest-revision signed review sheet (revision 7 at 18:29 beats revision 4 per protocol note BBFF51AD), which states no boundary contact occurred before control was complete; the event sheet confirms bat contact, no overthrow, an agreed 4-run boundary allowance, 1 run completed, an in-time appeal, and the ball still in play with no No-ball call. The catch fails only on the boundary-contact element, so no dismissal is given (Laws 33.1-33.3, 31.1/31.3); the 1 completed run plus the 4-run boundary allowance are batter runs (Laws 19.6-19.7, 21.15), the ball being live until the terminal event. Counterfactual changes only boundary_contact_before_completion to contact before control: the catch is invalidated (Law 33.3), so no dismissal; the 1 completed run stands and the boundary allowance of 4 still applies as the agreed allowance (Laws 19.6-19.7), giving 4 batter runs; the ball remains live at the terminal event.

CASE-775440578B (OBS-28D460BD): the scoring-room transcript records no No-ball call, bat contact, an agreed boundary allowance of 4, and a boundary from the delivery without overthrow; no runs completed and no appeal or wicket event are recorded. The delivery is legal; the bat-struck boundary scores 4 runs to the striker (Laws 19.6-19.7, 21.15 scoring rule), the ball is live through the boundary and dead at the terminal event. Counterfactual changes only no_ball_called to a No-ball call: the delivery becomes a No-ball, adding 1 No-ball extra; the 4-run boundary allowance is preserved and classified by contact as batter runs (Law 21.15), for 5 total, all debited to the bowler; no dismissal is available (Law 21.17) and the ball remains live at the wicket-free terminal event.

CASE-EE9238E63E (OBS-ED8A2FD3, 11:27 over 22): the synchronized observation records no No-ball call, no bat/person contact, 0 runs completed, an in-time appeal, and a wicket put down by a method satisfying the wicket-put-down record, with the event sheet confirming the wicket-keeper alone put down the wicket and the transcript confirming the striker was out of ground and not attempting a run. All elements of Law 39.1 are met, so the decision is Stumped on a legal delivery scoring nothing; the ball is live at the wicket event and dead at the terminal event. Counterfactual changes only wicket_fair to not fairly put down: Stumped fails for lack of a fairly put down wicket (Law 39.1), no other dismissal category is supported by this incident's facts, so no dismissal; the legal delivery scores nothing and the ball remains live at the terminal event.

CASE-2370BE579C (OBS-F5A69F82, 13:38 over 37): the synchronized observation records no No-ball call, no bat/person contact, 0 runs completed, and a fielding-side appeal; no wicket event is recorded, so despite the appeal no dismissal can be given (Laws 31.1/31.3 require a wicket event). The delivery is legal for 0 runs and the ball is dead at the terminal event. Counterfactual changes only no_ball_called to a No-ball call: the delivery becomes a No-ball adding 1 No-ball extra with no contact and no completed runs (Laws 21.14-21.15); the appeal cannot produce a dismissal on a No-ball (Law 21.17), and the ball remains live at the terminal event.

CASE-4D5C964234: the incident log records a No-ball call and the synchronized observation confirms the ball touched neither bat nor person with 0 runs completed before the terminal event; no appeal or wicket event is recorded, so no dismissal is available. Under Law 21.14-21.15 the No-ball adds one No-ball extra; with no contact and no completed runs there are no batter runs. The delivery remains a No-ball (counts in over per Law 21.16) and the ball is dead after the terminal event. Counterfactual changes only no_ball_called to no call: with no bat/person contact the delivery becomes a legal ball scoring nothing, and the ball is dead at the terminal event; all other facts unchanged.

Actual: synchronized observation records a Wide call; event sheet records no bat/person contact; incident log records 0 completed runs and no boundary, appeal or wicket event. Wide adds one Wide extra (Laws 22.6-22.7), does not count in the over (22.8), and the extra is debited to the bowler. Counterfactual changes only wide_called to no Wide call: with no contact, no completed runs, no boundary and no wicket event, the delivery is legal, all accounts are zero, and the ledger falls back to the zero record.

No completed runs are recorded, so all accounts are zero and the delivery counts in the over. Counterfactual changes only out_of_ground to the batter having made ground: the Stumped precondition fails, so no dismissal is recorded; the delivery remains legal and counts in the over, and the active source remains the highest signed revision (9) under the review-lock protocol.

CASE-4D60E86B31 resolves to OBS-7CD8001E. Facts: striker's-end signal log records a Wide call; ball touched neither bat nor person; striker not attempting a run; wicket-keeper alone put down the wicket; fielding side appealed before next delivery and Time. Law 22.8 (Wide not a ball of the over) and Law 22.9 (Stumped possible after Wide) apply; Law 39.1 Stumped conditions are all met (Wide is not a No-ball, striker out of ground and not attempting a run, keeper alone put down wicket), so STUMPED. Wide adds 1 plus any completed runs (none recorded) as WIDE_EXTRA; batter_runs 0; bowler_runs 0; counts_in_over false. Counterfactual changes only attempting_run to true, which defeats Law 39.1's not-attempting-a-run condition, so no dismissal; delivery status and Wide scoring are unchanged.

实际：死球在击球员获得击球机会前被叫出（r25fact_8edc7e0821d659a3f89f），球未触及球棒或人身（r25fact_ff5efa027946e4cf3731），跑动得分为0（r25fact_73241dff050642fc9a6e）。依 Law 20.7.1.1（r25rule_b8122bd5baa1d779b8a6），该球不计入 overs，重投球无得分：DEAD_REBALL、counts_in_over=false、全账目为零。反事实仅改写 early_dead_reball 为'无死球中断'，其余事实不变：球仍未触及球棒或人身、跑动为0，故为无得分合法球，计入 overs。无任何出局证据，dismissal 保持 NONE。

实际：投手端有 No-ball 呼叫（r25fact_497d07f5c12120db401b），击球端有 Wide 呼叫（r25fact_50d1e32dd137804ca8ce），球触及击球员球棒（r25fact_e09a009f3418389d256a），终端事件前完成1跑（r25fact_db323a801f2392ec45ae）。依 Law 21.12，No-ball 任何时候压过 Wide（r25rule_c30185f2ff2f6ba4192f）→ NO_BALL；No-ball 加1个 No-ball 额外分，完成跑动按接触归类（r25rule_7b664029），球棒击出的跑动记入击球员（r25rule_9cd66743bacf5abb3ae0）：BATTER 1 + NO_BALL_EXTRA 1 = 总2，投手账 = 1+1 = 2；No-ball 不计入 overs（r25rule_bd964657）。反事实仅改写 no_ball_called 为'无 No-ball 呼叫'：Wide 呼叫本就因球触及球棒而依 Law 22.3.1 撤销（r25rule_401494961ac2f5887931），故成为合法球，1跑记入击球员，计入 overs，投手账仅1跑。

实际：破桩时球仍在比赛中（r25fact_ded44a9582f31666b71b），提交裁定类别为 Run out（r25fact_3373ea926668d8f5b7aa），破桩端击球员出界（r25fact_551983446ac16d3809c9），破桩方式满足 wicket-put-down 记录（r25fact_130040d3c27b4b5e59b3），终端事件前完成1跑（r25fact_a8f7089eec12cd0d23e6）。Run out 三要件齐备（r25rule_b61cf0bc）→ RUN_OUT。松球在出局事件之后才到边界（r25fact_9db60191a0d626da755c），依 Laws 20.1/20.6 死球后的边界接触不得为该球记边界分（r25rule_cccc13c4）→ boundary_allowance=0，1跑记入击球员，投手账=1。守方已上诉（r25fact_14b9526156ace1550b45），满足 Law 31 上诉要件（r25rule_b855cce5）。反事实仅改写 dead_before_wicket 为'球在破桩前已死'：依 r25rule_cccc13c4，死球后破桩不构成出局 → dismissal NONE；跑动为0、无边界 → 全零合法球，仍计入 overs。

实际：17:22/over 36 事件单记录该 wicket 事件提交于 Stumped 与 Run out 之间裁定（r25fact_09143ee66f4d28406932），守方已上诉（r25fact_6b3fe6274b185009957d，满足 r25rule_b855cce5）。击球员出界且未试图跑动（r25fact_3cdc69dfcdea4c86dcad、r25fact_657ac1f05e993c7d882b），破桩方式满足记录（r25fact_c5b70fd384dd5abcbe0a）。keeper_only 的两个已签署复核版本冲突：rev 3 记'非守桩手外野手参与'（r25shadow_edf251cdd8e3bc4d658c），rev 7 记'守桩手单独完成'（r25fact_bf02030da35d76621d90）；依协议取修订号最高者（r25policy_c47d5b613f227b1447b9）→ keeper_only=true。球未触及球棒或人身（r25fact_19e5ec23018a2210d5f7）→ 无跑动无边界；击球端 Wide 呼叫因未触及而成立（r25fact_e2b7f3b39304f97ee4d4、r25rule_75ab8d9c），但 Wide 之后仅剩 Stumped/Run out 等出局可能（r25rule_99b7aebd），Stumped 要件全部满足（r25rule_4b953eb1）→ STUMPED，WIDE，0分。反事实仅改写 keeper_only 为'非守桩手外野手参与破桩'：Stumped 被排除（r25rule_4b953eb1），Run out 三要件仍齐备（r25rule_b61cf0bc）→ RUN_OUT；Wide 与0分不变。

实际：16:30/over 14 的 wilful_deception 有两份已签署复核：18:22 版记'无外野手故意欺骗'（r25fact_1a2e7546307f6cc750ef），18:29 版记'击球员接球后外野手故意欺骗'（r25shadow_70a8c57bc5239e0c8228）；复核锁为18:25，协议取锁前最新签署版本（r25policy_96f24422b68f9e391252）→ wilful_deception=false，Law 41.5 不触发。投手端 No-ball 呼叫（r25fact_b96d16e0041d0f8f23db）压过一切（r25rule_c30185f2ff2f6ba4192f）→ NO_BALL，不计入 overs（r25rule_bd964657）；球触及球棒（r25fact_01c368512b78f64106cd），完成1跑记入击球员（r25fact_4526ee608f5ac0d8feb0、r25rule_9cd66743bacf5abb3ae0），加 No-ball 额外1（r25rule_7b664029）：总2，投手账=1+1=2。Run out 类别虽被提交（r25fact_faab232794b678e17d40）但 No-ball 下不得判 Run out（r25rule_99b7aebd）→ NONE；上诉已满足（r25fact_14b9526156ace1550b45、r25rule_b855cce5）。反事实仅改写 wilful_deception 为'接球后外野手故意欺骗'：依 Law 41.5（r25rule_1ba5040a）球死、阻止出局、该球不计、罚5分，保留已完成跑动 → BATTER 1 + NO_BALL_EXTRA 1 + PENALTY 5 = 总7；罚分不记投手账（r25rule_35c9b39c），投手账仍为2。

Actual (18:33, over 3): two signed review entries conflict on the No-ball call — revision 3 says no No-ball, revision 9 says No-ball. Protocol note 1546CF7D fixes the review lock at 18:25 and selects the latest signed entry at or before the lock → revision 3 (18:33 entry is later, next cycle). So no_ball_called=false; striker's-end Wide call stands (no revocation fact), 1 run completed → WIDE, 1 Wide extra, not counting in the over. Counterfactual: no_ball_called=true → Law 21.12: No-ball overrides Wide; delivery NO_BALL, +1 No-ball extra to the bowler, the completed run is not re-classified (no contact/boundary facts), ball live until called dead.

Actual: no No-ball call (incident log), ball touched striker's bat (scoring-room transcript) then broke the wicket (event sheet), timely fielding appeal (synchronized observation + incident log), Bowled category submitted. Law 32.1 allows Bowled after first touching the striker's bat, so dismissal BOWLED on a LEGAL delivery; no runs completed, ball dead at the wicket, zero ledger. Counterfactual: No-ball call active → Law 21.17 removes Bowled (dismissal NONE), delivery NO_BALL, +1 No-ball extra debited to the bowler; ball remains live until called dead.

Actual: striker's-end Wide call (event sheet), no bat/person contact (scoring-room transcript), boundary off the delivery without overthrow (synchronized observation), agreed allowance 4 (scoring-room transcript). Wide stands (no revocation fact), so WIDE, not counting in the over; 1 Wide + 4 boundary allowance = 4 Wides extras, none to the batter or bowler. Counterfactual: bat contact → Law 22.3.1 revokes the Wide; delivery becomes LEGAL, the 4-run boundary is batter runs (Law 19.6-19.7), credited to the striker and debited to the bowler; ball live until called dead.

Actual (14:00, over 36): contact conflict — signed review 18:22 says bat touched, signed review 18:29 says no bat/person contact. Protocol note 1546CF7D: review lock 18:25 → latest at-or-before-lock wins → 18:22 entry, contact=true. But the bowler's-end No-ball call (incident log, 14:00 over 36) is later in the same delivery sequence and Law 21.12 overrides the striker's-end Wide → effective status NO_BALL (not counting in the over). 2 runs completed, then overthrow boundary (fielder's throw, batters crossed) with allowance 4: Law 21.14-21.15 classifies all 2+4 as No-ball extras; no bowler debit (no batter runs). Counterfactual: contact=false → the 18:22 entry is superseded in the counterfactual world only; source-selection status stays LAST_PRE_LOCK with the 18:29 entry now active. Wide call stands (no No-ball revocation applies — the No-ball call is at the bowler's end for a separate signal and Law 21.12 still overrides it) → WIDE; 1 + 2 + 4 = 7 Wides extras (Law 22.6-22.7 + Law 19.8), not counting in the over, no bowler debit.

Actual (18:00, over 34): striker's-end Wide call, no bat/person contact, 2 runs completed, then boundary from a fielder's throw with batters already crossed, allowance 4. Law 22.6-22.7 + Law 19.8: 1 + 2 + 4 = 7, all Wides extras; WIDE does not count in the over; no bowler debit. Counterfactual: batters had NOT crossed → the run in progress is excluded; 1 + 2 + 4 = 7 becomes 1 + 2 + 4 minus the uncrossed run = 5 Wides extras (Law 19.8 counts the in-progress run only if batters had crossed). All other facts unchanged.
